name: PBR Material Baker
actions: bake a seeded PBR material family
inspect albedo normal ORM emissive and height maps
export explicit PNG candidates and a receipt
summary: Bake deterministic local albedo, tangent-space normal, packed ORM, emissive, and height maps for six game-material families with measurable signal and explicit review boundaries.
notes: The baker provides PS3-era material infrastructure, not a PS3-quality claim. Candidates remain memory-only until explicit export and never promote themselves into the asset library.
